units.source_scale_reason: Guides are the accepted paintings at their accepted scale; every video frame keeps one fixed extraction scale and anchor.

visual_review.notes: Reviewed on H3 video. Cast v1 and death v1 are clean; the pieces apart from the body in the death are the staff and bowl dropping to the ground, and in the hit they are ribbon ends. Idle v1 held its guides and popped; idle v3, guided by the neutral pose alone, loops smoothly. Every attack take flashed or shot a beam from the crescent, and the densely guided ones held each guide and popped, so attack v1 cuts from the raised staff (26) to the clean lunge (40), skipping a vanishing staff and the beam. The ranged takes glowed, sprayed water or lost frames to plate pulses until ranged v7 described a plain push of a solid dish; it is clean. Defend v1 lost most of the guard to rejected plates; defend v3, guided through the painted guard poses and told to brace smoothly over about a second, is used without a few frames with a sliver on the ground (10-19). The walk keeps the published clip.
